Gideon's corrected figure for Vantorre Group is 280 seats. I've posted that to you in our DM.

In the July 1 thread in #strategic-pod, he first said 300. About five minutes later he retracted it, because he'd been reading a staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout. He said 280 is the active seat count on the production roster as of July 1.

That count is from July 1. If the QBR deck needs a more recent number, check it before you use it.
